about_the_game:
Valerie is a 2D adventure game by Jole that mixes lively retro-inspired platforming with a personal story.

The Unbound Mind was a book that sparked great controversy; many who read it mistakenly believed it had opened their mind to paranormal powers. Very few truly grasped its rigorous teachings, but from those who did, The Unbound Society was formed - a small elite group with ambitious ideals and intent to impose greater order.

-

The story follows a girl named Valerie who was able to attain these powers, but was separate from those ideals. Her mother, wishing to realise the high expectations she had for her daughter, discovers The Unbound Society, and takes her to them in the hope that they can light the way to Valerie's future.

Her powers aren't all that useful for fighting, but they're fun! Use the boost ability to propel yourself and the bubble-gun ability to trap things in bubbles. With a bit of practice, these powers will let you find your own way to traverse the landscape and solve puzzles.

Features

  • Funky and unique platforming with bubbles, boosts and bouncing

  • Character-driven story

  • A cozy, light-hearted sprinkle of humour

  • Artwork and soundtrack created by the developer, Jole

  • Secret collectibles to find such as trinkets and health power-ups

  • Bonus content designed for those looking to get more out of the game

  • Lots of cats (sometimes)

Wishlist the game today and follow on social media!
